id_policy: Immutable UUIDv5-based IDs; retain existing IDs after label edits. Episode numbers and watch order are separate mutable fields.

provenance.conversion_scope: Loss-preserving format conversion; no new canon research or software
provenance.revision_scope: Editorial revision of the existing research; IDs, evidence catalogs, original fields, and uncertainty preserved. No new source verification is claimed.

uncertainty_policy: Unspecified dates remain null. Textual references do not prove scene presence. Estimates and unresolved descriptors stay labeled. All chronology prose is preserved verbatim.
